The EX-70-H2C is a high-performance video distribution solution designed for both residential home theaters and multi-media conference halls, capable of extending full 4K@60Hz (4:4:4) and 18Gbps signals up to 70m (230ft) over a single Cat6/6a cable. It includes an HDMI OUT loop-out on the TX unit for a local monitor, and features essential functionalities like bi-direction IR pass-through for remote device control, bi-direction POC (Power over Cable) for flexible power delivery, and ARC (Audio Return Channel) support with an S/PDIF audio de-embedding port, all packaged in a compact, durable steel chassis.

Includes an HDMI OUT port on the TX unit to connect a local display (loop-out). It also supports ARC (Audio Return Channel), allowing audio from the remote TV to be sent back and de-embedded via the S/PDIF output on the RX unit.

EDID Management: Supports EDID control via a switch on the TX unit, allowing the user to select from fixed resolutions (1080P@60Hz or 4K@60Hz) or copy the EDID from either the TX (source) or RX (display) unit for guaranteed compatibility.

Features Power over Cable (POC), meaning only one power supply is needed for either the TX or RX unit, simplifying installation. It also supports bi-direction IR pass-through for controlling source devices from the display location and vice versa.
